page.layout: One printed page, single text column with a decorative fleuron at the top; brace-grouped dedicatee lists with small marginal-style text to the right of the brace groups (treated as notes beside their names); no running head, no page number printed in the text block (faint page number "21" in the top-left corner is show-through and omitted); no catchword or signature. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.

main_text.head: Plurimum Reverendis, Clarissimis atq; Doctissimis Viris,
main_text.p: Venerabili atq; spectabili Domino Decano, reliquisq; Dominis Pastoribus Vigilantissimis, Theologo spectatissimo p. t. Rectori Magnifico, Dominis Professoribus Solertissimis, DN. Gymnasiarchae meritissimo, adeoq; toti venerando coetui Ecclesiastico, Dominis suis Mecaenatibus, fautoribus atq; promotoribus, nullo honoris & obsequij genere satis demerendis.
main_text.head: Ut Et
Consultissimo, Spectatissimo atq; Gravissimo Viro
main_text.p: DN. JOHANNI GEORGIO IM HOFF, Reipubl. Bernensis Senatori prudentissimo, fautori suo nullo non honoris & Reverentiae cultu prosequendo.
main_text.head: Nec Non
Prudentia, pietate & probitate conspicuis Viris,
main_text.p: DN. DAVIDI à RÜTHI, DN. JACOBO WYSSIO, DN. WERNERO GREBERO, Ducentum viris dignissimis patriaeque salutis studiosissimis fautoribus ac cognatis suis omni officij genere demerendis
main_text.head: Quin Etiam
Reverendis & Doctissimis Viris,
main_text.p: DN. MAURITIO RINGIERO, DN. JOHANNI ROLLIERO, Illi in Lozwyl huic in Diesbach, verbi divini praeconibus indefessis cognatis ac benefactoribus omni honoris genere prosequendis.
main_text.head: Tandem
main_text.p: DN. DANIELI HEMMANO, DN. DAVIDI à RÜTHI, Illi vineae Dei in Rhynach cultori indefesso, huic Not. publ. civi Reipub. Bernensis perito, Affinibus suis dilectissimis.
Hasce studiorum Theologicorum primitias, dicat; dedicat JOHANNES GRUNERUS, Auth. & Resp.

page.notes: Printed names and dedicatees are set in small capitals; the brace-grouped text at right is treated as marginal notes. Ornamental fleuron at top. The word "Rhynach" in the brace note is in black letter and is rendered as printed; uncertain readings: "Lozwyl" and "Diesbach" as printed. Several line-ends are unclear in the scan.
